Inventario v0.3.0 reshapes how items are described and entered, adds a Trash, server-side drafts and an inbox, and gives operators tenant management in the back office. Every change, with its issue, is in the [0.3.0 section of CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/denisvmedia/inventario/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md#030---2026-11-28).

## Before you upgrade from v0.2.x

The steps are in [PRODUCTION.md, "Upgrading from v0.2.x"](https://github.com/denisvmedia/inventario/blob/v0.3.0/PRODUCTION.md#upgrading-from-v02x). In short:

- **Scale the Deployments to zero before `helm upgrade`.** The upgrade applies 30 migrations, and v0.2.x pods fail against the result.
- **Check the database URLs.** A `postgres://` DSN with an `@` after the host is refused before anything connects. Percent-encode `/`, `?` and `#` in a password as `%2F`, `%3F` and `%23`, and an `@` in the database name or a query value as `%40`.
- **Give each custom domain to one tenant.** The migration that makes tenant domains unique stops when two tenants share one; `inventario db migrate up --dry-run` names them.
- **Upgrade release by release.** v0.3.x moves file attachments out of columns that a later release drops, so run it until the move has finished before you upgrade further.
- **Purge old logs and rotate passwords.** Earlier releases wrote the database DSN with its password on every `inventario db migrate up`, and could write database and Redis passwords, signed URL signatures and parts of refused request bodies in other cases.
- **Subscription plans are hidden** unless you set `--enable-plans` (Helm `features.plans`), and finished currency migrations older than 90 days are deleted unless you raise `--currency-migration-retention` first.

## What is new

- **Describing items.** Item types each group keeps and edits, custom fields of nine kinds with filters, sorting and columns, a Collection set of types and fields for collectors, brand and model, sellers, and asset IDs with printable QR labels.
- **Entering items.** Drafts saved on the server and finished on any device, an Inbox of unfinished work, Add items from files with the AI scan reading receipts in the background, and documents delivered by other systems such as Paperless-ngx.
- **Finding and changing items.** Search across serial numbers, part numbers, tags and notes, a tag and a location filter, saved views, photo cards, and bulk edits of tags, type and status.
- **Keeping track.** A Trash for deleted items and files, item reminders and an Upcoming page, your own reminder lead times, Donated and Stolen statuses, and files attached to several items at once.
- **Accounts.** Personal API tokens for scripts, a download of your own data, profile photos, a What's new page, and sign-in with a self-hosted OpenID Connect provider.
- **Operations.** Tenant management in the back office, a list of failed background jobs with retry and discard, and `inventario jobs failed` on the command line.
